desc: When you take a Magic action to remove the stopper of this painted brass bottle, a cloud of thick smoke flows out of it. At the end of your turn, the smoke disappears with a flash of harmless fire, and an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmEfreeti0000000]{Efreeti} appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you.
name: efreeti bottle
